_comment: EXTI line sources measured on physical silicon where the reference manual and the EVT header disagree. pipeline/extract/rm/extract_exti_lines.py adds the measurement to the claims for that line as `measured:<method>(<record>)`; the measured source is the one kept, and the row stays `conflict` because the documents still disagree (the same policy as register-fields-measured.json). This file never creates a line; it only settles a source a document already states.

measured.how: ch32rv core (f58a1dab) enabled only USBHS1WakeUp (vector 58) for EXTI line 18 and only USBHS2Wakeup (vector 84) for line 20, then fired each line by software interrupt; on CH32V407WEU6 both lines reported attached 1, calls 1 (junit property `swi`). With the reverse mapping neither handler would have run. RM table 9-6 says 18 = USBHS1, 20 = USBHS2; EVT ch32v4x7_exti.h says the reverse.
